title: Audit signed R429 integer range and atomic error sensitivity
body:
## Summary

Audit the saved R429 sign variant: 23 quotient ADD signs change while the complete binary map, 429 arbitrary integer helper returns and paid rank mass 4989 remain unchanged. A fixed prefix–quotient–suffix proof bounds forward source and target changes by ranks 9 and 3 for all `2^47` sign choices; this witness attains both.

The source-selected scalar controller has a smaller range upper bound, but the new exact adjoint calculation shows mixed error sensitivity. Forward sensitivity worsens, while inverse ADD sensitivity improves and the inverse MOVE/COPY aggregate stays unchanged. See `research/r429-signed-range/README.md` and its two proof notes.

## Scope and limits

The controller is explicitly instantiated with the actual 1,499-ADD source code. Its archived 6,372-gate listing has a different binary endpoint; an independent free noncommuting schedule proof justifies the abstract substitution. The old six-copy suffix receipt is not reused for these three-copy words.

Range bounds and exact atomic error constants belong to the specified normalized scalar model, including conditional COPY/ERASE assignments. They do not admit native child interiors, physical cleanup, a precision law or a supplier. No sign optimality, paid-profile improvement, selected-record change or new kappa is claimed.

## Test plan

- [x] CPython 3.12 committed-byte/source-history preflight and all four registered commands.
- [x] Read-only Git-free export replay with unchanged inputs.
- [x] Separate AI integer, range/defect and verification reviews, with findings resolved.
- [x] Automatic [registered-package CI](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39420789468) passed on `4323518ffa8a8a9885bd1d81df6f3dae2dd3f6a9` (plan and package replay).

Checks cover all 651 public columns in both orientations and roundtrips, every COPY/ERASE cut and frame event, the fixed nine-dimensional transfer certificate, all 16,102 atomic suffixes in each word/direction, and attaining input/error witnesses. Full compressed receipts retain complete coverage; normal/optimized controls test intended failures and deliberate check deletion. No sign search is rerun.

## Sources and credit

The immediate word is #3645, with Ali Romman/#1043 and Sagar Thakrar/#2423 transport/rehosting ancestry and prior #1307 geometry. #4185 supplies the separate controller accounting boundary; its paid deficit is unchanged. Exact source bytes, retained notices, heads and storage encodings are recorded in the package manifests. Original sign witness, independent mathematical checks, new proofs and publication were prepared by Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. AI review is separate from human acceptance or formal-kernel proof. Apache-2.0.
